newsitem.title: USA: CORTECH INC SAYS FOCUSED ON ALTERNATIVES.
newsitem.headline: CORTECH INC SAYS FOCUSED ON ALTERNATIVES.

text.p: Biopharmaceutical company Cortech Inc said on Thursday that it was exploring ways in which to realize value on stockholders' investment in the company.

"At this point, management is significantly focused on exploration of strategic alternatives by which to realize appropriate value for our stockholders out of Cortech's tangible and intangible assets," said Cortech chief executive Kenneth Lynn.
"A key, near-term objective of management has been the conservation of cash, and we downsized the company in the second quarter to limit our rate of spending," Lynn added.
